author: Malachi (the name means "my messenger")
audience: Jews in Judah after the exile
overview: Malachi confronts careless worship, broken marriages and injustice, in a series of questions and answers. It promises that God will send his messenger, "Elijah", before the great day of the Lord.
storyPlace: The last book of the Old Testament in Christian Bibles. The Gospels see John the Baptist as the promised messenger.
